description: Scrape coverage and freshness, the VictoriaMetrics ingestion/store pipeline and vmagent delivery. New self-scrape panels populate after the Loem metrics configuration is activated.

panels.description: Fraction of configured scrape targets currently healthy. A failed scrape stays visible as up=0. Current value uses only source samples received within two minutes; missing telemetry is unavailable. Historical charts use the selected time range separately.

targets.expr: 100 * sum((up{host=~"$host"} and (time() - timestamp(up{host=~"$host"}) < 120))) / count((up{host=~"$host"} and (time() - timestamp(up{host=~"$host"}) < 120)))

panels.title: Targets reporting

panels.description: Number of samples emitted in the last scrape across the selected hosts; useful for noticing an exporter or collector disappearing. Current value uses only source samples received within two minutes; missing telemetry is unavailable. Historical charts use the selected time range separately.
panels.title: Scraped samples

panels.description: Time since the Nix store cache metrics file was updated. A steadily growing age means the textfile producer stopped, even when node exporter stays up. Current value uses only source samples received within two minutes; missing telemetry is unavailable. Historical charts use the selected time range separately.
panels.title: Textfile metric age

panels.description: Queued bytes waiting to reach VictoriaMetrics. Requires vmagent self-scrapes; persistent growth indicates stalled delivery, while a brief small queue is normal. Current value uses only source samples received within two minutes; missing telemetry is unavailable. Historical charts use the selected time range separately.
panels.title: Remote-write pending

panels.description: Percentage of successful scrape attempts in the trailing five minutes. Each host/job is separate, so a single missing target cannot hide behind fleet averages.
panels.title: Target availability · five-minute average

panels.description: Time spent on each scrape. Compare with the configured timeout below when a target becomes slow.
panels.title: Scrape duration

panels.description: Percent of the target's configured scrape timeout consumed by each scrape. Values near 100% precede timeout failures.
panels.title: Scrape timeout budget used

panels.description: Samples before and after relabeling are normally the same here. Changes can reveal lost collectors or unexpectedly high cardinality.
panels.title: Samples per scrape

panels.description: Failures from collectors used by these machines, plus the textfile parse/read error flag. Unsupported optional hardware collectors routinely report zero and are not treated as incidents.
panels.title: Core collector failures

panels.description: Age of each textfile metric producer. A rising age reveals a stalled producer even when node exporter remains healthy; parse/read failures appear in the core collector panel.
panels.title: Textfile freshness

panels.description: Pending on-disk delivery queue per agent. Inspect this alongside push failures when network outages or ingestion service moves interrupt delivery.
panels.title: Buffered remote-write data

panels.description: Compressed bytes successfully sent by each vmagent to its configured ingestion endpoint.
panels.title: Remote-write send rate

panels.description: Current failure/drop rates. Push failures can be retried; dropped packets indicate permanently discarded delivery batches and should be investigated.
panels.title: Remote-write failures and lost packets

panels.description: Resident memory for the exporters and services that expose process metrics. Missing processes are not assumed to consume zero.
panels.title: Exporter process memory

panels.description: Samples accepted per second by VictoriaMetrics from remote write. This is downstream acceptance, while vmagent queue/sent metrics describe upstream delivery.
panels.title: Accepted ingestion samples

panels.description: Storage component size reported by VictoriaMetrics, including its small/big data parts and in-memory buffer.
panels.title: Stored data size

panels.description: Free disk space on the filesystem containing VictoriaMetrics data. Falling free space can force the storage into read-only mode.
panels.title: Storage free disk space

panels.description: One means VictoriaMetrics has stopped accepting writes. Zero is writable. A self-scrape failure remains visible in target availability above.
panels.title: Storage read-only state

panels.description: Errors per second by endpoint. Lifetime counts are not shown as current alarms; query errors and write errors have different operational causes.
panels.title: VictoriaMetrics HTTP errors

panels.description: Rate of queries exceeding VictoriaMetrics' slow-query threshold. Compare a rising rate with CPU/I/O pressure on the fleet dashboard.
panels.title: Slow queries

title: Monitoring · scrape and storage
